name: Pedrola (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire with white triangles at the hoist and fly bearing chequered crescents, and the bars of Aragon in the upper and lower triangles.
history: Municipal flag of Pedrola; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chequered crescents of yellow and black on the white triangles
bars of Aragon in the upper and lower triangles
red bars in the upper and lower triangles
